About us

At Logmind, we work to revolutionize how IT sees, thinks and acts and, in that way, future-proof our clients' IT operations with AIOps and automation

Our vision

Empower organizations to thrive and innovate without friction, by streamlining their IT operations with AI-powered intelligence

Our mission

Become the AIOps superpower of IT teams, turning manual reactive IT firefighting into proactive automation
